# ListItem

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:list-item` · Kerf UI · component · Navigation

Configurable native-button action rows and native-anchor navigation rows with structured labels, status/busy metadata, density, group dividers, protected domain metadata hooks, and rounded-boundary overflow clipping.

## When to use

Selectable, disabled, trailing, and multiline action or link rows.

- Render a selectable, disabled, trailing, or multiline sidebar action row whose descendants must remain clipped to the rounded row boundary; use ListItemLink when the destination has an href and needs native link activation.
- A settings or command row identifies each entry by a colored icon tile (iconTile) instead of a bare glyph.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for an ordinary inline link, form button, isolated ARIA menuitem, or an interactive trailing action; use ListActionRow for sibling row actions.
- Do not inject declaration strings; use className, public tokens, and cataloged component props for application styling.

**Alternatives:**

- [ListActionRow](./list-action-row.md) (nearest) — The trailing region must be independently interactive.
- [SummaryRow](./summary-row.md) (nearest) — Use SummaryRow for dense selectable item summaries with metadata.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/list-item` — exports `ListItem`, `ListItemLink`, `wireListReorder`, `reorderListItems`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/list-item` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/list-item.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireListReorder` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-list-reorder` (optional).
- Wiring: `reorderListItems` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-list-reorder` (optional).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/list-item`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuilist-item), [`@kerfjs/ui/wire-list-reorder`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiwire-list-reorder) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- native link and external link
- selected
- pressed
- disabled
- trailing
- multiline
- placeholder (loading)
- compact density
- spacious density
- centered icon beside a multiline label
- drag-target state
- draggable row with dragging and drop-before / drop-after insertion states
- description and status
- busy while retaining content
- before, after, or paired group divider
- position-aware divided-list corners: flat wherever a divider line (this row's or a neighbor's) meets the edge
- filled leading icon tile (iconTile): a quiet tone preset (neutral, brand, success, warning, danger) or an application fill with an optional foreground; a 32px rounded tile holding an 18px glyph

**CSS-value props** (typed builders from `@kerfjs/ui/css-values`; raw CSS strings are rejected):

- `style`: declarations grammar; raw values: forbid — e.g. `className="app-row"`

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md), [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** routing; link destinations; selection; permissions; action handling; domain data attributes; row order.

**Wiring:** `wireListReorder`, `reorderListItems` is optional.

**Wiring-owned state attributes** — never render, remove, or branch on these as app state:

- `data-dragging` on `ListItem / ListItemLink rows being dragged` (`wireListReorder`): "true" on every row a pointer drag is moving (the dragged row, or every selected row of its list when the dragged row is selected). Same attribute the `dragging` prop renders.
- `data-drop-position` on `ListItem / ListItemLink row under the pointer` (`wireListReorder`): "before" or "after": the edge of this row the dragged rows would land beside. Same attribute the `dropPosition` prop renders.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: navigation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Public resting, hover, and selected text, fill, and border tokens can be scoped to a row or its containing list without changing the default tones.

## Accessibility

- ListItem uses native button activation and pressed maps to aria-pressed; ListItemLink uses native anchor activation and external opens a new tab with safe rel and an announced default label. Both map selected to aria-current; disabled or loading links omit href and leave the tab order. rootAttributes cannot add role=menuitem or replace owned ARIA; trailing is dormant content and must not contain controls. A draggable row reorders by pointer drag or, with wireListReorder, Alt+Shift+ArrowUp/ArrowDown; a placeholder is never draggable.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-list-item`, `kui-list-item__icon`, `kui-list-item__label`, `kui-list-item__primary-label`, `kui-list-item__description`, `kui-list-item__status`, `kui-list-item__trailing`.

Never put `kui-list-item`, `kui-list-item__icon`, `kui-list-item__label`, `kui-list-item__primary-label`, `kui-list-item__description`, `kui-list-item__status`, `kui-list-item__trailing` on an element you write; render `ListItem` instead (`KUI-L103`).
